response.prediction: Another general concept that applies to elements of commutative rings is that of **irreducible elements**. In addition to prime elements, irreducible elements are fundamental in the study of the factorization properties of rings. While every prime element is irreducible in the ring of integers, in more general commutative rings, the two concepts may differ.
